_comment: HOW TO ADD A PROJECT: copy this file to <your-id>.json (e.g. my-new-app.json), fill in the fields, delete this _comment line. Drop your cover image at public/projects/<your-id>/cover.png and set imageUrl to /projects/<your-id>/cover.png — or paste an https:// image URL. Set order to control gallery position (1 = first). Keep highlights to 3 short bullets and outcome to one line — the modal shows those, not paragraphs. Delete a project's .json to remove it. Run npm run validate:content to check.
title: My New Project
description: One-line summary shown on the gallery card (keep under ~140 chars).
summary: Two to three lines shown in the project modal — what it is, what you did, what it achieved.
role: Your role, e.g. Design + front-end build
outcome: One-line result, e.g. 40% faster time-to-insight for execs
highlights: First key point — what you did or decided
Second key point — how you built or designed it
Third key point — what it achieved
